simple.meaning: מְחַבְּרָה (mᵉchabbᵉrâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a joiner , i.e. brace or cramp.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 1 Chronicles 22:3. The surrounding context includes kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְחַבְּרָה (H4226) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

timeline.evidenceText: David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the couplings; and bronze in abundance without weight;
